name: letta-llm-config
title: Letta LLMConfig
description: Flat structure summary of the Letta LLMConfig entity, derived from the Letta OpenAPI 1.0.0 spec.

fields.name: model
fields.description: LLM model name.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: A human-friendly display name for the model.

fields.name: model_endpoint_type
fields.description: The endpoint type for the model.

fields.name: model_endpoint
fields.description: The endpoint for the model.

fields.name: provider_name
fields.description: The provider name for the model.

fields.name: provider_category
fields.description: The provider category for the model.

fields.name: model_wrapper
fields.description: The wrapper for the model.

fields.name: context_window
fields.description: The context window size for the model.

fields.name: put_inner_thoughts_in_kwargs
fields.description: Puts 'inner_thoughts' as a kwarg in the function call if this is set to True. This helps with function calling performance and also the generation of inner thoughts.

fields.name: handle
fields.description: The handle for this config, in the format provider/model-name.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: The temperature to use when generating text with the model. A higher temperature will result in more random text.

fields.name: max_tokens
fields.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate. If not set, the model will use its default value.

fields.name: enable_reasoner
fields.description: Whether or not the model should use extended thinking if it is a 'reasoning' style model

fields.name: reasoning_effort
fields.description: The reasoning effort to use when generating text reasoning models

fields.name: max_reasoning_tokens
fields.description: Configurable thinking budget for extended thinking. Used for enable_reasoner and also for Google Vertex models like Gemini 2.5 Flash. Minimum value is 1024 when used with enable_reasoner.

fields.name: effort
fields.description: The effort level for Anthropic models that support it (Opus 4.5, Opus 4.6). Controls token spending and thinking behavior. Not setting this gives similar performance to 'high'.

fields.name: frequency_penalty
fields.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. From OpenAI: Number between -2.0 and 2.0.

fields.name: compatibility_type
fields.description: The framework compatibility type for the model.

fields.name: verbosity
fields.description: Soft control for how verbose model output should be, used for GPT-5 models.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: The cost tier for the model (cloud only).

fields.name: parallel_tool_calls
fields.description: Deprecated: Use model_settings to configure parallel tool calls instead. If set to True, enables parallel tool calling. Defaults to False.

fields.name: response_format
fields.description: The response format for the model's output. Supports text, json_object, and json_schema (structured outputs). Can be set via model_settings.

fields.name: strict
fields.description: Enable strict mode for tool calling. When true, tool schemas include strict: true and additionalProperties: false, guaranteeing tool outputs match JSON schemas.

fields.name: return_logprobs
fields.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens. Useful for RL training.

fields.name: top_logprobs
fields.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position (0-20). Requires return_logprobs=True.

fields.name: return_token_ids
fields.description: Whether to return token IDs for all LLM generations via SGLang native endpoint. Required for multi-turn RL training with loss masking. Only works with SGLang provider.

fields.name: tool_call_parser
fields.description: SGLang tool call parser name (e.g. 'glm47', 'qwen25', 'hermes'). Used by the SGLang native adapter to parse tool calls from raw model output.
